mapper.sql: select o.order_id, o.order_no, o.resident_id, u.nick_name as resident_name, o.dept_id, d.dept_name, o.repair_type, o.title, o.description, o.address, o.contact_name, o.contact_phone, o.urgency, o.images, o.status, o.worker_id, w.nick_name as worker_name, o.dispatcher_id, o.dispatch_time, o.accept_time, o.finish_time, o.finish_result, o.cancel_reason, o.is_overtime, o.evaluate_flag, (select e.score from repair_evaluation e where e.order_id = o.order_id limit 1) as score, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.update_by, o.update_time, o.remark from repair_order o left join sys_user u on u.user_id = o.resident_id left join sys_user w on w.user_id = o.worker_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = o.dept_id
mapper.insert:
insert into repair_order
order_no, resident_id, dept_id, repair_type, title, description, address, contact_name, contact_phone, urgency, images, status, worker_id, dispatcher_id, dispatch_time, accept_time, finish_time, finish_result, cancel_reason, is_overtime, evaluate_flag, create_by, remark, create_time

mapper.delete:
delete from repair_order where order_id in
#{orderId}
mapper.select: select count(*) as total, sum(case when status = 'pending' then 1 else 0 end) as pendingCount, sum(case when status = 'assigned' then 1 else 0 end) as assignedCount, sum(case when status = 'repairing' then 1 else 0 end) as repairingCount, sum(case when status = 'completed' then 1 else 0 end) as completedCount, sum(case when status = 'rated' then 1 else 0 end) as ratedCount, sum(case when status = 'cancelled' then 1 else 0 end) as cancelledCount, sum(case when is_overtime = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as overtimeCount, sum(case when date(create_time) = curdate() then 1 else 0 end) as todayCount from repair_order
select repair_type as name, count(*) as value from repair_order group by repair_type order by value desc
select status as name, count(*) as value from repair_order group by status

select date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') as name, count(*) as value from repair_order where create_time >= date_sub(curdate(), interval #{days} day) group by date_format(create_time, '%m-%d') order by name

select w.worker_no as workerNo, w.worker_name as workerName, count(o.order_id) as orderCount, sum(case when o.status in ('completed','rated') then 1 else 0 end) as finishCount, ifnull(round(avg(e.score), 1), 0) as avgScore from repair_worker w left join repair_order o on o.worker_id = w.user_id left join repair_evaluation e on e.order_id = o.order_id group by w.worker_id, w.worker_no, w.worker_name order by finishCount desc, avgScore desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update repair_order set is_overtime = 1 where is_overtime = 0 and ( (status = 'pending' and timestampdiff(minute, create_time, now()) >= 120) or (status = 'assigned' and timestampdiff(minute, dispatch_time, now()) >= 120) or (status = 'repairing' and timestampdiff(minute, accept_time, now()) >= 1440) )
mapper.select: where o.status = 'pending' and o.is_overtime = 1 order by o.create_time asc limit 50
select count(*) from repair_order where worker_id = #{workerId} and status in ('assigned', 'repairing')
select count(*) from repair_order where resident_id = #{residentId} and status = 'completed'
